{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()

# Filter for completed orders
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Exclude QA orders from completed orders
completed_clean = completed_df[~qa_mask]

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA)
mean_revenue = completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Verify premises
assert completed_clean['status'].eq('completed').all(), "Some non-completed orders were included"
assert qa_count == 6, "Expected 6 QA orders"
assert completed_clean['revenue_clean'].isna().sum() == 0, "No missing revenue after cleaning"

# Print final result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding 6 QA orders): {mean_revenue:.2f} USD")"}
